title: Austin Forms Health Care Task Force
summary:
*   A new "Health Care Task Force" was officially named and its 13 members were appointed.
*   The committee's discussions centered on legislation for a Health Services and Financing District and progress on an indigent care study.
*   The task force's immediate next step will be to draft its specific mission and charge.

Discussion of Task Force for Health Services and Financing District
A. Task Force Name
The Committee unanimously approved HEALTH CARE TASK FORCE as their official name.
B. Task Force Membership
The following were selected as members of the Task Force on a 4-0 vote on Councilmember
Garcia's motion, Councilmember Nofziger's second: Dr. Christopher Chenault, Betty
Himmelblau, Kevin Reed, Jim Joy, Mary Lou Adams, Ed Berger, Richard Klusman, Carl
Sieganthaler, Roseanna Szilak, Charles McQuaery, Regina Rogoff, Raphael Quintella and
Donna Knapp.
